## 更新内容 / Changes

- Codex 桌面适配改为按实际资源和功能结构检测。页面语言、普通 / Fast 和 Ultra 独立判断，兼容的客户端更新无需仅为新增版本号重新登记。
- 启动预览显示当前客户端版本和三项功能状态；某一项结构变化时，其他已兼容功能仍可加载。
- 恢复 Codex 26.1002.52244 中自定义 API 实例的中文界面、原生速度切换和模型支持的 Ultra 档位。Fast 不再等待自定义供应商没有的 ChatGPT 订阅信息；仍保留上游明确禁用 Fast 的判断。
- 保留官方语言偏好和模型能力声明。使用 ChatGPT 原生登录的实例只启用语言适配，速度和推理继续由客户端管理。
- 增加客户端结构变化、独立功能回退、速度请求参数和 Ultra 保存的回归验证。

- Codex desktop integration now detects actual resource and feature structures. Language, Standard/Fast and Ultra are checked independently, so compatible client updates do not require a new version entry.
- The launch preview displays the installed client version and each feature's status. A changed feature no longer disables the other compatible features.
- Restores Chinese localization, native speed controls and model-supported Ultra in custom API instances on Codex 26.1002.52244. Fast no longer waits for unavailable ChatGPT subscription metadata; explicit upstream Fast denial remains respected.
- Preserves explicit language preferences and model capability declarations. Instances using native ChatGPT login receive language integration only; native speed and reasoning behavior remain client-managed.
- Adds regression coverage for resource changes, independent feature fallback, speed request parameters and Ultra persistence.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。升级前退出管理器，再安装新版；账号、实例与本地配置保留。新适配在重新启动 Codex 实例后生效。应用内自动更新、Developer ID 签名和公证尚未接入。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Quit the manager before installing an update; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. Restart a Codex instance to apply the new integration. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持与验证 / Client support and validation

Codex 需单独安装；已在 26.1002.52244 的隔离实例中验证界面语言、普通 / Fast 的请求档位以及 Ultra 选择与保存，使用本地模拟 API，不消耗真实账号额度。实际 Fast 服务和 Ultra 仍取决于模型与服务商。客户端接口变化时仍可能需要适配，不能保证所有未来版本自动兼容。Claude Code、Claude Desktop 等其他客户端尚未接入。

Codex must be installed separately. Language, Standard/Fast request tiers and Ultra selection/persistence were verified in an isolated instance of 26.1002.52244 against a loopback mock API, without using live account quota. Actual Fast service and Ultra depend on the model and provider. Changed client interfaces may still require adaptation; compatibility with every future version is not guaranteed. Other clients, including Claude Code and Claude Desktop, are not yet implemented.

## 构建来源 / Build provenance

源码对应 `v0.4.0` 标签。安装包由该标签触发的 GitHub Actions「Build release」工作流构建、验收并校验上传后的文件；附件提供 SHA-256 校验清单。

Source is identified by the `v0.4.0` tag. Installers are built and verified by the tag's GitHub Actions **Build release** workflow, including downloaded-asset verification. The attached SHA-256 manifest identifies the published packages.
